name: Flic en Flac Beach
description: Long white sand beach perfect for swimming and snorkeling. Popular with locals and tourists. Many restaurants nearby.

name: Grand Baie Beach
description: Lively beach with calm waters. Water sports hub. Vibrant nightlife and shopping area.

name: Le Morne Beach
description: Stunning beach at foot of Le Morne mountain. UNESCO site. World-class kite surfing.

name: Trou aux Biches Beach
description: Pristine white sand beach with crystal clear water. Excellent snorkeling. Family-friendly.

name: Belle Mare Beach
description: Powdery white sand stretching for miles. Turquoise waters. Ideal for long walks.

name: Blue Bay Beach
description: Marine park with incredible coral reefs. Perfect for snorkeling. Glass-bottom boat tours.

name: Tamarin Beach
description: Popular surfing spot. Black sand in some areas. Dolphin watching tours depart from here.

name: Pereybere Beach
description: Small sheltered beach. Calm waters perfect for children. Local food stalls nearby.

name: Ile aux Cerfs Beach
description: Idyllic island beach accessible by boat. Water sports paradise. Restaurants and beach clubs.

name: Mont Choisy Beach
description: 3km of white sand. Less crowded than nearby beaches. Popular for picnics.

name: La Cuvette Beach
description: Hidden gem protected by rocks. Calm waters. Sunset views. Snorkeling spots.

name: Riambel Beach
description: Secluded beach with local charm. Horse riding on beach. Authentic village atmosphere.
